top_deficiency_types.title: Have approved installation, maintenance and testing program for fire alarm systems.
Provide exit doors that are held open by devices that will automatically close on the activation of a fire alarm or smoke detector.
Keep aisles, corridors, and exits free of obstruction in case of emergency.
Ensure that special areas are constructed so that walls can resist fire for one hour or have an approved fire extinguishing system.
Ensure proper usage of power strips and extension cords.

top_deficiency_types.title: Procure food from sources approved or considered satisfactory and store, prepare, distribute and serve food in accordance with professional standards.
